title: [PM seat] domain:ui · seat 2 — 🟢 os-steve · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责
body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 2**, opened on the maintainer's word to add a seat to the lane (「你现在就可以增加席位啊」, project chat 2026-10-26T08:17Z). Seat 1 is #25966. No `domain:ui` seat-2 post existed in the `pm:seat` index (open or closed) when this one was raised.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-steve` · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责 (Claude Code project "objectstack ui", seat thread "接管 ui 车道派发(席位 2)") · `session_01SMps7wq7rBTk53e8KTSEup` · seated 2026-10-26.
- **File area (split with seat 1, by fix-landing package):** seat 2 = `ui/packages/` plugin-list, plugin-grid, plugin-detail, plugin-form, plugin-view, fields, plugin-kanban, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-map, plugin-timeline, plugin-tree, plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report. Seat 1 (#25966) = every other `domain:ui` path. A card spanning both goes to the seat owning its main landing package. Seat 1's in-flight cards stay with seat 1 until MERGED. Claims carry `Seat: domain:ui#2`.
- **Hot-file serial queue:** read #25966's queue too — one card per file across both seats. `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` — ⛔ out of bounds for every ui card for now (maintainer's word in the project). Seat 2 holds no file yet.
- **Standing constraints (maintainer, project chat):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR is opened on the objectui repository; every `ui/packages/**` source change re-records `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`.
- **Pointer:** posture and ledger live in the project; canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: domain:ui#2` + `head:claude/` PRs.
- **Wall:** none.
